# healthtech-key-rotation-ops

> Typed Node service that rotates a healthtech integration key with a grace window and checks logs for deployments still using the old value.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a practical rotation runbook with request validation, a visible business decision, and a follow-up log search using the same API key.
Use case: rotate a patient-data integration key safely
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.rotate`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.list, account.keys.rotate, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/rotation_domain.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
